blocks.html: Deep Sea Fishing Cabo San Lucas – Experience the Marlin Capital of the World!

Discover deep sea fishing in Cabo with Exotic Fish Cabo, offering private offshore fishing adventures in the waters of Los Cabos, Mexico.

Our charters depart from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo, providing access to productive offshore banks and deep-water fishing areas in the Sea of Cortez.

Depending on the season and ocean conditions, anglers can target marlin, yellowfin tuna, dorado, wahoo, and other pelagic species.

With experienced local captains, quality fishing equipment, and private 6-hour and 8-hour trip options, Exotic Fish Cabo welcomes both first-time visitors and experienced offshore anglers.
Why Deep Sea Fishing in Cabo San Lucas Stands Out

Few places on Earth offer consistent big-game action year-round. Cabo San Lucas boasts deep drop-offs just miles from the marina, nutrient-rich currents, and migratory highways for pelagic giants. Our experienced local captains know the waters inside out, putting you on fish fast with proven techniques like trolling, live bait, and kite fishing.

  • Epic fights against powerful game fish

  • Professional crews with decades of local knowledge

  • Top-tier gear: Penn, Shimano, and custom setups

  • Eco-friendly practices: Catch & release for billfish to protect the resource

Top Species You'll Target on Deep Sea Fishing Trips in Cabo

Our offshore charters focus on the stars of the deep:

  • Striped Marlin, Blue Marlin, Black Marlin – Iconic trophies! Peak season December–June, but possible anytime.

  • Yellowfin Tuna – Hard-fighting giants up to 200+ lbs, especially summer–fall.

  • Dorado (Mahi-Mahi) – Vibrant, acrobatic fighters abundant most of the year.

  • Wahoo – Lightning-fast speedsters often caught as bonuses.

  • Sailfish and occasional other pelagics.

Many trips feature multiple hook-ups – imagine a double or triple marlin strike!

Prime Deep Sea Fishing Spots Around Cabo

We head to the hottest offshore zones based on conditions:

  • Gordo Banks: Legendary for trophy marlin and big yellowfin.

  • Santa Maria Canyon: Billfish haven with dorado and tuna trolling.

  • Golden Gate Bank and 1150 Banks – Deep waters loaded with pelagics.

  • San Jaime Bank (Pacific side) – Prime for blue marlin.

All Exotic Fish Cabo deep sea fishing charters depart exclusively from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo, Mexico.

Guests staying in Cabo San Lucas are welcome to book our private fishing trips, but must travel to Puerto Los Cabos Marina for departure.

Best Time for Deep Sea Fishing in Cabo – Year-Round Action

December–MayStriped/Blue/Black Marlin dominant72–79°F (22–26°C)Peak "Marlin Season" – tournament-level actionJune–OctoberYellowfin Tuna, Dorado, Wahoo79–86°F (26–30°C)Warm waters bring migratory giantsYear-RoundMixed bags (Dorado, Tuna, occasional billfish)VariesAlways productive – Cabo rarely disappoints!

No bad time to fish here – one of the few global spots with reliable big game 365 days a year.

What's Included in Our Deep Sea Fishing Charters

Exotic Fish Cabo offers private 6-hour and 8-hour fishing charters departing exclusively from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo.

Every private fishing charter includes an experienced local captain and crew, fishing rods, reels, and basic tackle. Boat capacity and onboard amenities depend on the selected charter.

6-Hour Private Fishing Charters – From $350 USD per boat

An excellent option for couples, families, and small groups. Starting prices apply to selected boats for 1–2 guests.

8-Hour Private Deep Sea Fishing Charters – From $600 USD per boat

Enjoy additional time offshore targeting seasonal species such as marlin, yellowfin tuna, dorado, and wahoo.

Our fishing trips normally depart at 6:30 AM. Fishing locations are selected according to weather, ocean conditions, and seasonal fish activity.

Mexican fishing licenses, live bait, food, drinks, transportation, and fish-cleaning services vary by charter. Our team will confirm all inclusions and any additional costs before booking.

All trips are private, with final pricing depending on the selected boat and group size.

Why Choose Us for Deep Sea Fishing in Cabo?

  • Local expertise honed over years on these waters

  • Safe, well-maintained fleet with all required certifications

  • Focus on fun, safety, and memorable experiences

  • Happy clients: "Best day ever – landed our first marlin!" (like top reviews on TripAdvisor)

  • Sustainable fishing: We promote release of billfish and respect the ocean

Deep Sea Fishing Cabo FAQ

Minimum group size? Private from 1–2 people up to 10 depending on boat.

What if we don't catch anything? Cabo's waters are world-class, but nature rules. We use the best spots, techniques, and real-time intel to maximize success.

Family/kids friendly? Absolutely! We adjust for all ages and skill levels.

How to book? Click "Book Now" or contact us via WhatsApp/form. High season fills fast!

Book a private fishing charter with Exotic Fish Cabo and explore the offshore fishing opportunities of the Sea of Cortez.

All our fishing trips depart exclusively from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo. Guests staying in Cabo San Lucas are welcome to book our 6-hour and 8-hour private charters.
